summary: Maywood Acquisition Corp. 2 filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 11.5M units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $115M, and a simultaneous private placement of 140K units to sponsor West Pike for $1.4M. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share, one right (1/4 share upon business combination), and one warrant ($11.50 strike). Proceeds were placed in trust. This is a blank-check IPO formation event, not a special situation. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring are present.
